summary.zh-TW: 向供應商賒購商品 {{money:param.amount}}，貨先收、款後付，先記應付帳款。
summary.en: Buy goods worth {{money:param.amount}} from a supplier on credit: the goods arrive now, payment comes later, so trade payables are recorded.

explanation.zh-TW: 賒購時現金還沒付出去，存貨先增加，同時多了一筆對供應商的應付帳款。因為沒有動到現金，現金流量表這一步沒有變化；等日後付款時，才會出現在營業活動。
explanation.en: With a credit purchase no cash is paid yet: inventory rises and a trade payable to the supplier is recorded. Because cash is untouched, nothing appears on the statement of cash flows at this step; the payment shows up under operating activities when it is made later.
